summary:
Main
The previous recovery did not persist, with domestic futures and spot prices retreating today. DCE most-traded closed at 671.0 yuan/mt,down 0.52%. The 61%, 58% and 65% port indices were 651, 605 and 813 yuan/wmt: the low-grade index held steady while the others eased.
